component.name: PrivacyNotes
component.summary: Notes, tasks, and journal, encrypted on your device

description.p: PrivacyNotes is one private place for your notes, tasks, and journal, encrypted on your device. With self-custody, your recovery phrase is the only key, and the server holds nothing that opens your notes.
It works offline and syncs across your devices, always encrypted, on your device and on the way to the server.
